long.text: Learn to shape clay into something worth keeping, and build a small collection of my own finds in the house.
long.reason: Clay is good and so are things I have claimed, and I mean to have both in one place.

steps.reason: Seeds that grow without permission still bother me, so I will find out how they do it.
The flowers in the garden are mine, and I want the claim on record again.
The lookout rock is mine, and it should be on record too.
I will sit on the lookout rock where I can see who is coming up the beach.

today.reason: The reading and photographs still owed to me can be done now, and then I will take the high place for the rest of the afternoon.
